posts.author: Jeff Fletcher
posts.text: Kurt Suzuki called that Ryan Johnson's best game of the year. Josh Lowe hit a HR just in time for him to get a victory. www.ocregister.com/2026/09/15/r...
posts.jp: クルト・スズキがライアン・ジョンソンの今季最高の試合だと評価。ジョシュ・ロウが好タイミングで本塁打を放ち、ジョンソンが勝利を手にした。

posts.author: Matt Gelb
posts.text: Impressively, Phillies become the first MLB team in 71 years to walk 13 times in a nine-inning game but score only three runs. What a feat. (They won.)

reply_texts.text: In the words of John Hodgman, “Jesus fuck.”
reply_texts.author: eanasir.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: Except for the win, this is the most Phillies thing you could have posted.
reply_texts.author: stevenmcnabb.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: shows they really cant hit lol
reply_texts.author: acphila.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: Regardless of what happens from from now until the season ends, I'm going to need to see some inspired moves in the off-season. 2027 feels like the year the bottom falls out
reply_texts.author: marcc856.bsky.social

posts.jp: フィリーズが71年ぶりにナインイニングで13四球を記録したが、得点はわずか3点。驚くべき試合内容だ。(勝利した。)

posts.author: Meghan Montemurro
posts.text: Another multi-homer game for Pete Crow-Armstrong as he goes deep for his second of the night and 44th on the season. His 7th multi-HR game this season. The "M-V-P!" chants follow him around the bases at Wrigley as Cubs take a 7-2 lead in the 7th.
posts.jp: ピート・クロー=アームストロングが2打席連続本塁打で今季44号。今季7度目の複数本塁打試合。ラッグリーでMVP!の声援を受けながら走塁し、カブスが7回に7-2とリード。

posts.author: Meghan Montemurro
posts.text: Pete Crow-Armstrong slugs his 43rd home run of the season, passing HOFer Billy Williams' mark in 1970 for most homers in a single season by a left-handed hitter in franchise history. The homer puts the Cubs up 2-0 in the 3rd.
posts.jp: ピート・クロー=アームストロングが今季43号本塁打を放ち、フランチャイズ史上シーズン左打者最多本塁打のビリー・ウィリアムス(1970年)の記録を上回った。本塁打でカブスが3回に2-0とリード。

posts.author: Matt Gelb
posts.text: Zack Wheeler's 91st and last pitch was 96.6 mph. With seven scoreless innings, his ERA is back down to 2.99. He's had four strong ones in a row.
posts.jp: ザック・ウィーラーの91投目は96.6mph。7イニング無失点で防御率は2.99に低下。4試合連続で良好な投球を見せている。

posts.author: Tim Stebbins
posts.text: Final: Guardians 6, White Sox 3 Cleveland (78-75) has a half-game lead on Chicago (77-75) in the AL Central. First time with sole possession of first since morning of July 4.
posts.jp: 最終スコア ガーディアンズ6、ホワイトソックス3。クリーブランド(78-75)がシカゴ(77-75)をAL中部で0.5ゲーム上回る。7月4日朝以来初めての単独首位。

posts.author: Keegan Matheson
posts.text: #BlueJays win, 5-1. They are now 1.5 games back of the White Sox in the AL Wild Card race (and tied with the Rangers). They do not hold the tiebreaker over Chicago. They’re 76-77.
posts.jp: ブルージェイズが5-1で勝利。AL Wild Cardではホワイトソックスから1.5ゲーム差でレンジャーズと並ぶ。シカゴとのタイブレーカーは保持していない。成績は76-77。

posts.author: Chandler Rome
posts.text: The Astros won 4-2. They are 76-75. Yordan Alvarez and Jeremy Peña had all four of Houston's hits and drove in all four of their runs. Hunter Brown struck out 10 across five innings of one-run ball.
posts.jp: アストロズが4-2で勝利。成績は76-75。ヨルダン・アルバレスとジェレミー・ペーニャがヒューストンの4安打全て、得点全てを記録。ハンター・ブラウンが5イニング1失点で10奪三振。
